descriptor.name: Sicilia SITR public cadastral parcels
descriptor.scope: Regional cadastral parcel layer operated by Sicilia SITR, transformed from cadastral CXF interchange data. The municipal layer identifies the unchanged Acireale locator as A028; the frozen native samples use that municipality. This candidate requests technical qualification only within thirteen 0.001-degree cells and the sample footprint. Legal title, survey accuracy, currentness, long-term key continuity and wider municipal completeness remain unverified.

evidence: Frozen packet identifies Sicilia SITR layer 4 and six native cadastral reference fields; the service at https://map.sitr.regione.sicilia.it/gis/rest/services/catasto/cartografia_catastale/MapServer?f=pjson states regional cadastral cartography transformed from CXF interchange data (source-evidence/service.json).

The official schema at https://map.sitr.regione.sicilia.it/gis/rest/services/catasto/cartografia_catastale/MapServer/4?f=pjson identifies layer 4 as Particelle, polygon geometry, native string COMUNE/SEZIONE/FOGLIO/ALLEGATO/SVILUPPO/NUMERO fields and offset pagination (source-evidence/parcels-layer.json).

The official municipal query at https://map.sitr.regione.sicilia.it/gis/rest/services/catasto/cartografia_catastale/MapServer/9/query identifies the unchanged city point as Acireale, COD_CATAST A028; layer 4 independently returns frozen sample A028 / literal blank / 63 / literal blank / literal blank / 848 with COMUNE_T Acireale (source-evidence/city-scope.json and source-evidence/native-sample-scope.json).
